entry.author: Masterton District Council
entry.summary:
The Government is progressing changes to local government across New Zealand. The goal is to be more efficient so lots of small councils aren't doing the same work right next door to each other.

If we decide to take part in Head Start, our proposal needs to be submitted by 9 August. In both pathways, the Government gets final say on the new authorities, including which councils join them.

Have your say on the future by going to whatsup.mstn.govt.nz and completing the survey.
